children.title: RFK Jr. removes all 17 members of CDC vaccine advisory panel
children.description_medium: On June 9, 2025, HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced that all 17 members of the CDC’s Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices would be removed and replaced. Kennedy said the change was intended to restore public trust. Medical organizations and former officials criticized the mass removal. This panel action was separate from HHS workforce reductions affecting NIH.
children.description_long: On June 9, 2025, Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced that all 17 members of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices would be removed and replaced. Kennedy presented the change as an effort to restore public trust in the committee. Medical organizations and former officials criticized the decision to remove the full panel. The documented event concerns committee membership and the administration’s stated rationale for replacing the members. The supplied account does not provide a basis for labeling every replacement with a single political or scientific characterization, so such a generalization is not included here. This panel action is separate from workforce reductions associated with a broader HHS restructuring, including planned cuts to NIH positions and subsequent reports of employee reinstatements. The advisory committee decision should be dated to June 9, not merged into a February event about NIH staff.
children.date_uncertainty: Date is announcement date in contemporaneous Reuters reporting.

children.title: HHS restructuring includes planned NIH workforce reduction
children.description_medium: An HHS restructuring announced in April 2025 included plans to cut roughly 1,200 NIH positions. By June, HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said that 220 NIH employees who had been laid off were reinstated. These staffing actions were separate from Kennedy’s June 9 removal of CDC’s vaccine advisory committee members.
children.description_long: As part of a broader Department of Health and Human Services restructuring, the department planned major staffing reductions that included roughly 1,200 positions at the National Institutes of Health. Reuters later reported HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s June 24, 2025 testimony that 220 NIH employees who had been laid off had been brought back. The packet therefore supports a planned NIH workforce reduction and a subsequent reported reinstatement figure. Those details describe a workforce and restructuring matter, not a change to the membership of CDC’s vaccine advisory committee. The ACIP announcement, in which Kennedy said all 17 members would be removed and replaced, occurred on June 9 and was a distinct action. Because the available source is a June report discussing both plans and later reinstatements, the event date supplied for the restructuring is retained as April 1 with that reporting-date distinction made explicit.
children.date_uncertainty: Proposed event date for restructuring is April 1; supplied Reuters article is June 24 and reports later reinstatements.

rationale: The packet supports separate ACIP membership and NIH staffing actions. Generalizations about replacement-member ideology are excluded.
